base_recipe.name: 横画v16：压低后半段上扬，保留顿笔内收
base_recipe.description: Reduce only the paper-plane Y rise from local X15mm, smoothly transitioning to a 30% slope multiplier by X20mm; translate the existing dot/return without changing their relative geometry.
notes: XY paper-plane rise reduction only, not a change to final Z clearance.
X coordinates unchanged; Y slope transitions over local X15..20mm, retaining 30% thereafter.
Existing dot (+0.9,-1.2)mm and return (-1.5,0)mm translated as a rigid local shape.
Magnetic levels, local speed requests, PI limits, and normal final lift unchanged.
No early lift, stationary dwell, or validated prediction of ink shape.
